sketch:
Observe: time-domain scope (left) + magnitude spectrum (right),
linked. Student adds harmonics one by one to build a square /
triangle / sawtooth from Fourier partials — spectral bars grow as
the time-domain waveform sharpens. Experiment: given a target
time-domain waveform, pick the set of harmonics (frequency +
amplitude) that reproduces it. Evaluate: only spectrum shown;
student identifies the waveform family and its fundamental.
Wrinkle: windowing/leakage — a non-integer harmonic smears
spectral lines.
